title: MRFACE
summary: A customized Next.js frontend built to grow an artist's online presence and brand recognition.
description: A colleague and I planned, designed, and built this website for an up-and-coming artist who wanted to expand his reach beyond his locale and fortify his brand identity. We developed a unique, stylized website that brings his artwork to life through animation and hand-drawn fonts, mixing playful street style with professionalism. I built the artwork gallery — a modal with a carousel structure — keeping the modern, simplified feel of an art catalogue. As a result, the artist has increased both the sales and value of his artwork.
